veranderings.voor: die name van mans wat hulle meer as 150 jaar gelede gekoop het
veranderings.na: die name van die mans wat dit meer as 150 jaar gelede gekoop het
veranderings.rede: 'mans wat hulle ... gekoop het' can be read as 'men whom they bought'; 'die mans wat dit' makes the men the buyers and the scrolls the thing bought, and 'die' is needed because specific men are meant.

veranderings.voor: 'n towerspreuk oor die siek mens gesê
veranderings.na: 'n towerspreuk oor die siek mens opgesê
veranderings.rede: A prayer or spell is 'opgesê' (recited) in Afrikaans; 'oor iemand gesê' also reads as 'said about someone'.

vlae.teks: Die kanale dra bloed, ander soorte vloeistof en lug.
vlae.rede: This sentence sits between two belief-framed sentences ('het geglo', 'het gedink') but is itself a bare present-tense statement, so on its own it reads as a fact about the body rather than what the Egyptians believed. Fixing it (for example 'Volgens hulle dra die kanale ...') shifts the claim, so it is flagged for the writer rather than changed.
